title: Coach message
description: Structured output of every skill that produces a Telegram message (weekly-report, evening-recap, training-feedback, block-review, phase-review, phase-start). Code sends text to the coach chat and renders buttons. send=false means nothing is sent (the daily skills often decide this).

urgent.description: Only true for things that cannot wait for the weekly report (e.g. a proposal awaiting approval, a reset question for today's session).

text.description: Telegram-ready text. Empty string when send=false.

ref_id.description: Proposal id, session id or exercise id the button acts on.

deferred_to_weekly.description: Non-urgent observations held back for the weekly report (message limit).

context_note_suggestions.description: Optional: things the user said in reply that should become context notes (handled by coach-chat).
